{"script":"set -e
cd "$HOME"
for s in "$HOME/init.sh" "$HOME/.init.sh" "$PWD/init.sh" "$PWD/.init.sh"; do
  if [ -f "$s" ]; then
    bash "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
    found=1
    break
  fi
done
if [ -z "${found:-}" ]; then
  s=$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name 'init.sh' -o -name '.init.sh' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$s" ] && bash "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
d="$HOME/test"
c1=$(find "$d" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.*' \( -type f -o -type d \) | wc -l)
c2=$(find "$d" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name '.*' -name '*.txt' ! -empty | wc -l)
echo $((c1*c2))"}
